description: Strict backend interface that every mutation tool adapter MUST implement. The rest of ClariFin_OS calls ONLY this interface; it never invokes a specific tool directly.

discover.description: Discover mutations within scope. Returns enhanced candidates with canonical IDs.

generate.signature: generate(campaign: MutationCampaign, candidates: list[MutationCandidate], workspace: Path) -> Path
generate.description: Apply mutations to workspace and return path to generated state.
guarantees: Mutations applied only within workspace, never in-place in repo
Workspace is isolated from canonical repository

execute.signature: execute(candidate, test_selection, workspace, environment, timeout, worker_id, campaign_id) -> MutationExecution
execute.description: Execute one mutant against selected tests in isolated workspace.
guarantees: Process isolation: each execution in its own process group
Timeout enforced: returns TIMEOUT state if exceeded
Environment isolated: PYTHONPATH, working dir, temp files controlled
Never misclassifies tool crash as SURVIVED or KILLED

collect.description: Aggregate all execution records into canonical MutationResult.

resume.description: Resume a paused/interrupted campaign from last checkpoint.
guarantees: Pending mutants are picked up from checkpoint

cleanup.description: Clean up temporary workspace artifacts (keep evidence).

diagnostics.description: Return diagnostic information about current workspace state.

optional_hooks.verify_tool_version: Check backend meets minimum version requirement

current_adapters.name: mutmut
limitations: No native resume support (workaround: shard-based recovery)
Cache depends on .mutmut-cache (superseded by M44.12 canonical cache)
Discovery may silently skip some Python 3.12+ syntax patterns
